tally.citation: Bug describes LLM gate operation output/watchdog behavior in rebar orchestration; epic RP-02 concerns BindingStore persistence decomposition with no gate, orchestration, or output-streaming changes.
tally.title: Long-running LLM gate operations emit no incremental output, starving supervising agents' stall watchdogs

tally.citation: Bug is in rebar packaging/import infrastructure; epic RP-02 owns BindingStore decomposition and does not touch release packaging, MANIFEST, or _engine_support module distribution.
tally.title: Packaged rebar release omits _engine_support/commit_impact.py, breaking every close with file_impact

tally.citation: Epic AC 6 requires 'Load/check/dry-run/preview/selection/filtered tests prove zero recovery writes; only a validated write-bearing operation may repair an interrupted retirement' — the bug shows recovery writes occur in preview/dry-run despite persist=False, violating the epic's explicit no-write guarantee for non-write modes.
tally.title: Preview and dry-run passes perform remote Jira writes during pending-binding recovery

tally.citation: Epic S2 T2 moved absence/tombstone/comment lifecycle to binding_lifecycle.py; the integration test's clock-patch oracle no longer reaches the moved operations, weakening the regression detection that the epic's AC claims to preserve.
tally.title: Idempotency oracle no longer reaches moved binding clock reads

tally.citation: RP-02 S1 T1 deliberately pinned the broken dedup behavior during extraction; the epic's AC requires lifecycle tests prove both-index identity guards and append-only comment identity, but the alert dedup defect violates the documented dedup contract that the extraction was supposed to preserve.
tally.title: Binding lifecycle alerts never dedupe - records omit timestamp_ns
